title: Who Saw Her Die?
writer: Francesco Barilli, Massimo D'Avak, Aldo Lado
actors: George Lazenby, Anita Strindberg, Adolfo Celi
plot: A Venetian sculptor and his estranged wife pursue a mysterious, black veil-clad figure who has been murdering red-haired little girls - with the most recent victim being their daughter.
